title: Sick Leave Policy
description: Full-time employees are entitled to 12 paid sick leave days per calendar year. Employees must notify their manager before their shift begins. A medical certificate is required for absences exceeding 3 consecutive days. Unused sick leave does not carry forward.

title: Annual Leave Policy
description: Full-time employees receive 18 days of paid annual leave per year. Leave requests must be submitted at least 7 days in advance. A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the next year.

title: Work From Home Policy
description: Eligible employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Employees must remain available during standard working hours and comply with company information security requirements.

title: Maternity Leave Policy
description: Eligible employees may receive up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave, subject to applicable law and eligibility requirements. Employees should notify HR at least 8 weeks before the expected leave start date.

title: Paternity Leave Policy
description: Eligible employees receive 10 working days of paid paternity leave. Leave should normally be taken within 6 months of the child's birth or adoption.

title: Employee Attendance Policy
description: Employees must complete 8 working hours per day, excluding breaks. Standard office hours are 9 AM to 6 PM. Employees must record attendance through the approved attendance system.

title: Health Insurance Policy
description: Full-time employees are eligible for company-sponsored health insurance with annual coverage up to INR 500000. Coverage may include eligible dependents according to the selected insurance plan.

title: Probation Policy
description: New employees undergo a probation period of 6 months. Performance is reviewed before confirmation. During probation, the notice period is 15 days.

title: Employee Resignation Policy
description: Confirmed employees must serve a notice period of 60 days when resigning. Employees must complete the handover process and return company assets before their final working day.

title: Previous Annual Leave Policy
description: Employees previously received 15 days of annual leave per year. This policy has been replaced by the Annual Leave Policy effective in 2026.
